heading: Name and registration
text:
### Name and registration [LDTL.2.1]

`dynamic_ttl` is a construct capability of [LCAP.1]. A program has
`dynamic_ttl: true` through its dialect or a line of its `use` block
([LDIA.2.1]). `default` has `dynamic_ttl: false` ([LDIA.9.2]).

With `dynamic_ttl: false`, [LDTL.3.2] refuses a `retain:` duration kwarg on
an `emit` that targets a `ttl`-lifecycle schema. A `publish` takes no `retain:` in
any dialect ([LTIE.4.9]).  The schema-level TTL duration is the sole expiry
mechanism.
